paragraphs.text: 1. THIS pleasant meath, O Indra, is effused for thee: thou art the ruling Lord of beaker and of juice.
paragraphs.original: तुभ्येदमिन्द्र परि षिच्यते मधु त्वं सुतस्य कलशस्य राजसि ।
paragraphs.translit: tubhyedamindra pari ṣicyate madhu tvaṃ sutasya kalaśasya rājasi |

paragraphs.text: Bestow upon us wealth with many hero sons: thou, having glowed with Fervour, worthest heavenly light.
paragraphs.original: त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरामु नस्कृधि त्वं तपः परितप्याजयः स्वः
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīrāmu naskṛdhi tvaṃ tapaḥ paritapyājayaḥ svaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Let us call Sakra to libations here effused, winner of light who joyeth in the potent juice.
paragraphs.original: स्वर्जितं महि मन्दानमन्धसो हवामहे परि शक्रं सुताँ उप ।
paragraphs.translit: svarjitaṃ mahi mandānamandhaso havāmahe pari śakraṃ sutām̐ upa |

paragraphs.text: Mark well this sacrifice of ours and come to us: we pray to Maghavan the Vanquisher of hosts.
paragraphs.original: इमं नो यज्ञमिह बोध्या गहि स्पृधो जयन्तं मघवानमीमहे
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ no yajñamiha bodhyā gahi spṛdho jayantaṃ maghavānamīmahe

paragraphs.text: 3. By royal Soma's and by Varuna's decree, under Brhaspati's and Anumati's guard,
paragraphs.original: सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य धर्मणि बृहस्पतेरनुमत्या उ शर्मणि ।
paragraphs.translit: somasya rājño varuṇasya dharmaṇi bṛhaspateranumatyā u śarmaṇi |

paragraphs.text: This day by thine authority, O Maghavan, Maker, Disposer thou! have I enjoyed the jars.
4. 1, too, urged on, have had my portion, in the bowl, and as first Prince I drew forth this my hymn of praise,
paragraphs.original: प्रसूतो भक्षमकरं चरावपि स्तोमं चेमं प्रथमः सूरिरुन्मृजे ।
paragraphs.translit: prasūto bhakṣamakaraṃ carāvapi stomaṃ cemaṃ prathamaḥ sūrirunmṛje |

paragraphs.text: When with the prize I came unto the flowing juice, O Visvamitra, Jamadagni, to your home.
paragraphs.original: सुते सातेन यद्यागमं वां प्रति विश्वामित्रजमदग्नी दमे
paragraphs.translit: sute sātena yadyāgamaṃ vāṃ prati viśvāmitrajamadagnī dame
